chapters.reason: The paper introduces a byte-level architecture that uses dynamically sized patches as the primary unit of computation, which aligns with pretraining from scratch using latent-like representations instead of standard tokens.

The paper focuses on improving inference efficiency by using dynamically selected long patches, which effectively reduces the sequence length and computational complexity of the transformer architecture.
The model uses entropy-based segmentation to allocate compute dynamically, which functions as a form of adaptive budget allocation during the generation process.
